s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive lower urinary tract symptoms with urethral mass and amyloid protein deposition
salient_findings: Nocturia two to three times per night
key_facts: 53-year-old man
3-year history of lower urinary tract symptoms
No history of lichen sclerosis
No history of sexually transmitted infection
No history of pelvic radiation
No history of genitourinary trauma
No family history of genitourinary malignancy
Normal renal ultrasonography findings
Flexible cystourethroscopy revealed a circumferential urethral mass
Biopsy specimens were negative for carcinoma
Biopsy specimens demonstrated amyloid protein deposition
No additional disease manifestations of amyloidosis found
Retrograde urethrography showed a 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of lower urinary tract symptoms, including nocturia and slow urinary stream, along with the finding of a 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra on retrograde urethrography, are most consistent with a urethral stricture. The presence of amyloid protein deposition is an unusual finding but does not fully explain the patient's symptoms and urethrography results.

rejected.label: Amyloidosis
rejected.why: While amyloid protein deposition was found, there were no additional disease manifestations of amyloidosis, and the patient's symptoms and urethrography results are more consistent with a urethral stricture.
